title: How can I recreate this in RPG Makers

posts.author: skweezee
posts.body:
Ciao!
My friend Mario has been wondering how to make this dream a reality in his game. He's using RPGMaker VX Ace and wants to recreate South Park (N64)'s unique multiplayer mode in the RPGMaker style. He wants it to be as close as possible to the source, down to the very graphics. Anyone can help?
E.g

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Why isn't Mario making an account to ask questions? It's much easier to communicate with people directly.
This would be very difficult to accomplish.
- It's a completely different kind of game than RPG Maker is designed for
- RPG Maker is not designed to accept input from multiple sources/gamepads
- VX Ace has no 3D rendering engine for graphics like that. (neither do the other RPG Makers, but at least MV and MZ are more completely rewritable via plugins...it's still not a great idea)
- RPG Maker has no way to partition the screen and update them separately like that
I don't know to what degree any of this is possible in VX Ace. It's
possible
in MV and MZ, but it would be a lot of work and time - and, if Mario's not a coder, probably money in commissions. There are racing game templates for Unity that would provide a much closer starting point.
